apiUrl.title: API URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL for the crypt.fyi API (e.g. https://api.crypt.fyi). Must be a public http(s) URL — private/reserved literal IPs and internal hostnames are rejected.

webUrl.title: Web URL
webUrl.description: Base URL used when building share links (e.g. https://crypt.fyi). Must be a public http(s) URL — private/reserved literal IPs and internal hostnames are rejected.

burn.title: Burn after reading
burn.description: When true, secrets are deleted after the first successful read. Incompatible with read count (rc).

ips.title: IP / CIDR allow-list
ips.description: Comma-separated IP addresses or CIDR blocks allowed to read the secret (max 3).

rc.title: Read count
rc.description: Maximum number of successful reads (2–10). Only used when burn is false.

fc.title: Failure count
fc.description: Burn after this many failed read attempts (1–10).

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Public http(s) URL for vault event notifications. Must not target private/reserved addresses.

webhookName.title: Webhook name
webhookName.description: Optional label included in webhook notifications (max 50 characters).

webhookOnRead.title: Webhook on read
webhookOnRead.description: Notify when the secret is read successfully.

webhookOnFailPassword.title: Webhook on password/key failure
webhookOnFailPassword.description: Notify when a read fails due to password or key.

webhookOnFailIp.title: Webhook on IP failure
webhookOnFailIp.description: Notify when a read fails due to IP allow-list.

webhookOnBurn.title: Webhook on burn
webhookOnBurn.description: Notify when the secret is burned.
